headlines.snippet: Sergeant Ron Yonatan Reitman and Staff Sergeant Yuval Shay Soilem were killed in a shooting attack at the Gush Etzion junction. Reitman, 23, from Ashkelon, and Soilem, 20, from Hod Hasharon, served in the Nachal Brigade. Three other soldiers sustained moderate to light injuries. The IDF estimates that the attackers planned a major attack against civilians, which was thwarted by the soldiers' actions. The two attackers were eliminated, and an investigation is examining suspicions that a foreign photographer had prior knowledge of the attack. Netanyahu ordered an immediate closure of Hebron and preparations for a full lockdown in Judea and Samaria.
